text: One year of daily coffee could cost more than this toddler tub. Honestly though, I get why it seems overpriced. But when your baby outgrows their baby tub and the regular tub still feels too big, finding something in between is hard. Most options I found were for babies up to around six months, and even the ones that grow with your baby typically only go up to twelve months. My baby girl is fourteen months, and this Shnuggle tub is designed to be used up to age three. So we're definitely getting our money's worth. It has a supportive foam backrest, non-slip feet, and an easy-drain plug. It's sturdy and well-made, so you can potentially save it for your next toddler. But before you buy, check for coupons. If you catch a flash sale, even better, those deals can disappear. If you need one anyway, you might as well get it at a discount.
